Subject: Signing / evidence sequencing for UK addendum + SCCs

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the run-through yesterday. We need to lock an operational plan for signing the UK addendum and delivering the technical evidence for the SCC/TIA review. Legal here has three constraints: (1) we need a signed UK addendum before go-live in the UK, (2) some technical artifacts (keystore attestations, data flow diagrams) must be staged via SFTP or secure Drive with an audit log, and (3) procurement requires a short mutual action plan so our procurement ops can schedule payment and acceptance.

Two specific asks to get us moving:
- Can Redwood provide a deterministic signing sequence (DocuSign cadence) if we propose multi-phase signing (commercial DPA first, then UK addendum within 48h)?
- For the evidence handoff, can you produce an evidence matrix that maps each TIA/SCC requirement to a Redwood artifact and a responsible owner? We attached our SCC questionnaire (attached) for reference.

We are hoping to complete signing and initial evidence transfer by the week of July 6. Is that feasible?

Appreciate a short plan + owners so I can escalate internally.

Best,
Claire Evans
Senior Counsel, Contracts
Mediform Health

Claire — thanks, appreciate the clear asks. Looping legal and privacy to nail sequence & artifacts. High level:
- Signing: we can do a two-step DocuSign flow. Step A: core DPA (commercial + tech annex) — signatures from both sides. Step B (within 48 hours): UK addendum + execution copies. We can set an automated routing rule so the UK addendum only becomes active after both parties sign the DPA (DocuSign conditional routing).
- Evidence handoff: Kimberly will produce an evidence matrix mapping TIA items to artifacts (attestations, logs, diagrams). We can deliver via a secure file share and provide hash manifest + access log for your procurement.

Team: Kimberley/Kim, Laura — can you confirm owners and rough ETA? Jordan — I'm copying you so you can sync procurement and set the HubSpot milestone.

Thanks,
Dylan
Director, Sales Engineering | Redwood Inference

From: kimberly_park@redwood.ai
To: Claire Evans <claire.evans@mediform.com>, dylan_brooks@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai, jordan_blake@redwood.ai
Date: Wed, 01 Jul 2026 11:28:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Signing / evidence sequencing for UK addendum + SCCs

Claire / team — thanks for the questionnaire and timeline. Draft plan below (technical + compliance sequencing). Please review and flag anything missing.

1) Signing orchestra (DocuSign flow)
- Day 0 (contract owner): Redwood sends the commercial DPA bundle (core DPA + tech annex). Mediform signs.
- Day 0 + conditional routing: Once both signatures received, DocuSign auto-triggers the UK addendum envelope to Mediform and Redwood legal. Target: executed within 48 hours.
- Fallback: if UK addendum not executed within 72 hours, Redwood will deliver a temporary attestation letter (signed) confirming routing & safeguards until addendum is executed.

2) Evidence handoff window and artifacts (owner / delivery)
- Evidence matrix: owner Kimberly Park (redwood_privacy@redwood.ai). ETA: 48 business hours from acceptance of this plan. Artifact types: data flow diagram (PDF), KMS/HSM attestation (signed PDF), KV-cache/edge routing summary (CSV), audit log sample (redacted), network peering diagram (PDF).
- Delivery method: secure SFTP endpoint + signed manifest (SHA256 hashes) AND shared Drive link with access logs. We will provide one compressed package per artifact type and a CSV manifest.
- Auditability: each file will include an accompanying note with retention window, sampling method used for logs, and list of subprocessors implicated.

3) TIAs/DTIAs and SCC mapping
- We'll map each SCC clause to the TIA controls and indicate whether the artifact is an attestation, a sampled log, or a config extract.
- If you require full log exports for sampling, we need a signed data request addendum and a scoped time window.

4) Timeline and milestones
- 48 business hours: evidence matrix and DocuSign envelopes live.
- 72 hours: target for UK addendum signature or issuance of temporary attestation.
- Week of July 6: full evidence package delivery (assuming signoffs on schedule).

5) Owners and escalation
- Kimberly Park: evidence matrix, artifacts, attestation letters.
- Laura Bennett: privacy policy alignment and UK-specific clause signoff.
- Dylan Brooks / Jordan Blake: procurement cadence and HubSpot milestone ownership.
- Escalation path: internal legal -> VP Legal (cc address) -> CEO escalation if timeline materially slips.

Please confirm acceptance of the plan or provide any constraints (procurement blackout windows, legal redlines that require counterparty review).

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Data Protection | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_evidence_matrix_v2.csv (4.6KB)]
From: Tom Li <tom.li@mediform.com>

Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2026 15:44:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Signing / evidence sequencing for UK addendum + SCCs

Kim / Dylan — thanks, this plan looks good and very actionable. Two quick notes:

1) Procurement window: we have a payment blackout on July 7–9 (end of quarter close). If signing slips into that window we may not process the first invoice until July 12. Could you confirm whether any gating artifact is strictly required before we approve the first payment?

2) DocuSign routing: please send the two envelopes as proposed. We prefer the UK addendum to be auto-enabled only after the DPA is fully executed. If you can include the temporary attestation template in the first envelope as an attachment, that will speed approval if the addendum slips.

We'll review the evidence matrix and come back with any questions by Monday. Appreciate the manifest with hashes — that will satisfy our audit team.

Best,
Tom Li
Procurement Lead | Mediform Health
